caption: The drawing features a metallic object with a combination of curved and straight elements. On the left side, there is a vertical, elongated strip shaded in dark gray with two yellow or brass screws visible at the bottom. This strip arches over in a gentle curve to the right and forms a hook at its apex, secured by an intertwined, looped fastener in a brass color. Hanging from this hook is another metallic object, which appears to consist of a cylindrical container with a rounded top extending to a spout-like, upward curve. Two small yellow elements are attached near the top of this structure. The entire drawing is rendered in subtle gray, black, and yellow hues, set against a plain beige background. The image displays slight signs of wear or discoloration near the center left of the background.
title: Lamp
